leftSwitch.name: Previous Startpos
leftSwitch.description: Switches to the previous startpos, wraps around

rightSwitch.name: Next Startpos
rightSwitch.description: Switches to the next startpos, wraps around

toggleFavouritesMode.name: Toggle Favourites Mode
toggleFavouritesMode.description: Turns Favourites mode on or off. When on, you can only switch between favourited start positions and the counter only counts favourites

markFavourite.name: Favourite Startpos
markFavourite.description: Adds or removes the current start position from this level's favourites (shown in yellow)

hide.name: Don't fade on start
hide.description: Does not make the menu fade from max opacity when you first open a level

ignoreDisabled.name: Ignore Disabled
ignoreDisabled.description: Ignores start positions that have been disabled

favouritesByDefault.name: Favourites mode on by default
favouritesByDefault.description: Turns Favourites mode on automatically when you enter a level

showFavouritesLabel.name: Show Favourites text
showFavouritesLabel.description: Shows 'Favourites' above the switcher while Favourites mode is on

issues.info: If you have an issue with the mod please report it here!
